idea-plugin.name: Inline AI Prompt
idea-plugin.description: Edit Python code in place by asking the Claude Code CLI, without leaving the editor. Press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K (or use the editor context menu), type an instruction, and pick a thinking level. The plugin sends the selection, the enclosing function, the blank line or the current line to the local claude command line tool and receives the rewritten code. The result is applied as an inline diff that you accept or reject, as a single undoable edit. With no instruction at all, it can write code from a comment or from a function's name and docstring. Choose how hard Claude thinks (Think, Think hard, Think harder, Ultrathink), use slash commands such as /doc and /fix, and let it learn your project's API, database, Redis and cache-aside conventions once so generated code matches your style. Requires the Claude Code CLI to be installed and logged in.
